entities.summary: Santa Maria in Publicolis is a Baroque church in Rome. It is located in the rione of Sant'Eustachio. The facade was designed by Giovan Antonio de' Rossi. Santa Maria in Publicolis is a church building in Europe, established in 1643. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
